name: Agent Deep Modeling - ProjectSessionsPage Styling Alignment

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/pages/ProjectSessionsPage/**'
      - 'src/pages/SessionsNewPage/**'
      - 'src/components/SessionFormContainer/**'
      - '**.css'
      - '**.scss'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/pages/ProjectSessionsPage/**'
      - 'src/pages/SessionsNewPage/**'
      - 'src/components/SessionFormContainer/**'
      - '**.css'
      - '**.scss'

jobs:
  analyze-styling-consistency:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify CSS Module Structure
        run: |
          echo "Checking ProjectSessionsPage.module.css structure..."
          if [ -f "src/pages/ProjectSessionsPage/ProjectSessionsPage.module.css" ]; then
            echo "CSS module found."
            # Check for key styling patterns mentioned in the request
            grep -q "782px" src/pages/ProjectSessionsPage/ProjectSessionsPage.module.css && echo "Width constraint 782px found." || echo "Warning: 782px width constraint not found."
            grep -q "center" src/pages/ProjectSessionsPage/ProjectSessionsPage.module.css && echo "Center alignment found." || echo "Warning: Center alignment not found."
          else
            echo "Error: ProjectSessionsPage.module.css not found."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Compare Layout Patterns
        run: |
          echo "Comparing layout patterns between ProjectSessionsPage and SessionsNewPage..."
          # This is a heuristic check to ensure similar class structures or patterns exist
          if [ -f "src/pages/SessionsNewPage/SessionsNewPage.module.css" ]; then
            echo "SessionsNewPage CSS module found for comparison."
          else
            echo "Warning: SessionsNewPage CSS module not found for comparison."
          fi

      - name: Build Project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run Linting
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run Tests
        run: npm test -- --watchAll=false

      - name: Check for Visual Regression Artifacts (Placeholder)
        run: |
          echo "Note: Visual regression testing requires a dedicated tool like Percy or Chromatic."
          echo "Please ensure visual verification is performed manually or via integrated visual testing service."
